briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 escalate AGI race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployments while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4; Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3.5 with multimodal advances; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI and DeepSeek push competitive updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming reports highlight multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Microsoft and Google announce major data center expansions in Texas and Arizona; TSMC reports record AI chip orders.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace safety protocols by end of 2027?
